releases.notes:
This update of the Invasion Mod **fixes a regression and introduces small improvements**.
- **Added the config option `mobs-drop-small-remnants`** (default value: true). If set to `false`, Invasion Mod mobs will no longer drop Small Remnants on death. (Suggested by @brandyyn)
- **Fixed** `[player]'s life is now bound to the Nexus` message being shown every 5 minutes (**regression in v1.2.0**)
- Made the **Nexus GUI translatable** and added German localization for it
- Added **Simplified Chinese localization** (including Nexus GUI) (thanks @M3MEMonster)
- Various code quality improvements
- Removed an unused debug/duplicate Java class

**There are no gameplay breaking/altering changes in this update.**

**NOTE: This release incorrectly shows up as v1.1.5 in crash reports and logs!**

This is the first updated version of the Invasion Mod, bringing a lot of **QoL improvements as well as bugfixes**.
- **Chat messages are now colored and translatable** (also made many other improvements to them)
- **Added Nexus damage sound** and changed Nexus destruction sound
- Fixed a total of **11** missing sounds as well as their categories, allowing players to adjust the volumes (categories: "hostile" for wave begin and "master" for end sounds)
- Added German translation (if you're speaking any other language, I'd appreciate it if you created a PR containing any further translation!)
- Several QoL improvements to the /invasion commands
- Fixed Infused Sword heart particles not being visible to other players
- Items can now be shift-clicked into the Nexus
- Readded Waila support for the Nexus, now also showing Nexus wave and HP (the latter seems to not update correctly), compatible with the latest 1.7.10 version of Waila
- Reverted Material Probe crafting recipe change made in v1.1.5
- The Engineer's Hammer is now hidden in NEI
- Removed update checker
- Tiny performance improvements
- Slightly improved some log messages
- Added a Nexus logo in the mod list, certainly the most important change!

**There are no gameplay breaking/altering changes in this update.**

This is a re-release of v1.1.5, which was already available on some mirror websites as in well as the original forum thread. However, **the latest source code on UnstoppableN's GitHub repository still was v1.1.2**.
I've carefully analyzed the changes made between these two versions and updated the source code of [UnstoppableN's GitHub repo](https://github.com/UnstoppableN/Invasion-mod) to v1.1.5. **These changes are not "mine", I only reproduced the source code of that version.**

- Added config option "enable-log-file" to toggle logging of mod messages (default: _false_)
- Pig Engineers will now always continue to attack the Nexus if standing next to it
- Removed Waila support for the Nexus
- Increased explosion size of Boulder from 0.5 to 2.0
- Increased Primed TNT explosion size from 1.0 to 4.0
- IM Zombies can now also attack Iron Golems
- Altered Material Probe crafting recipe (now requires stick instead of blaze rod)
- Removed some debug messages and an unused model class

As this version was only made for the sake of completeness, **I do not recommend using this version to play. Use a newer, preferably the latest release instead.**
